title: High-entropy doping for high-performance zero-cobalt high-nickel layered cathode materials
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE05020G, Paper
Jiahui Zhou, Jiehui Hu, Xia Zhou, Zhen Shang, Yue Yang, Shengming Xu
Through high entropy doping strategy, zero-cobalt high nickel cathode materials exhibit stable structure and excellent electrochemical performance during charge and discharge processes.
